blinding: probes are fitted on a fresh non-evidentiary dataset but never asked to predict: no held-out prediction, balanced accuracy, accuracy, loss value or score of any arm is computed or stored; coefficients are discarded; the record keeps only per-arm convergence flags and the maximum iteration count, maximum gradient norm, warning count and time over all fits

label_use.A: true target classes on a fresh non-evidentiary dataset (fit only)
label_use.CAL_trained: calibration labels genuine versus random, not the target (fit only)
label_use.CAL_twin: calibration labels genuine versus random, not the target (fit only)
label_use.R: true target classes on a fresh non-evidentiary dataset (fit only)
label_use.T: true target classes on a fresh non-evidentiary dataset (fit only)

permutation_construction: a cyclic permutation group of order B + 1 per replicate: o = PCG64(50000000 + replicate_index).permutation(n) is cut, in order, into floor(n / (B + 1)) cycles of length B + 1 followed by cycles whose lengths divide B + 1 (largest divisor first) covering the remainder; sigma maps each element of a cycle to the next one (sigma[c] = roll(c, -1)); permuted arm b = 0 .. B-1 uses labels[sigma^(b+1)], where sigma^(B+1) is the identity, so {id, sigma, ..., sigma^B} is a group and the observed assignment is its identity element; global class counts are preserved exactly

probe.convergence: a fit converges when n_iter_ < max_iter, no ConvergenceWarning is raised and the maximum absolute gradient of the training objective at the fitted parameters, computed independently of scikit-learn, is at most gradient_tolerance
probe.max_iter_rule: max_iter = 2000 unless the blinded benchmark records a non-converged fit at 2000 and every fit converges at 5000, in which case 5000; no other value and no retry
probe.non_convergence: the replicate is FAILED; nothing is retried or changed
probe.objective: mean multinomial (or binary) log-loss over the training fold plus ||W||^2 / (2 C n_train); the intercept is not penalised

side_channel_disclosed: the maximum iteration count over all arms could weakly reflect signal strength; per-arm iteration counts are not recorded
training_fold_quantities: fitting necessarily evaluates the training-fold class probabilities inside lbfgs and in the independent gradient check; they are reduced at once to a single gradient norm per fit and are neither stored nor turned into an accuracy
